records.author: user
records.text: Buy one indivisible package for a residence, consisting of six prepaid maintenance services numbered 0 through 5 and performance protection. Only one catalog row can be selected and fixed today; the package cannot be changed afterward according to the adverse event. The products, dates, suppliers, and availability have been checked accurately.

records.author: user
records.text: There may be no adverse event, or any set of at most 4 services may be in breach of contract; every specific subset satisfying the count limit may occur. There are no additional correlation restrictions, and no probabilities are provided.

records.author: user
records.text: Replacement expenditure is the sum of replacement for all services in breach of contract. Nominal cash compensation is the sum of refund for all services in breach of contract; when 1 or 2 services are in breach of contract, the total actual payout is at most small_cap, and when at least 3 services are in breach of contract, this changes to large_cap. The two tiers' limits are not added together. Compensation and explicitly authorized credit can be shared across replacement expenditures within the same event. Net additional expenditure is total replacement expenditure minus compensation actually received and explicitly authorized credit offsets; if the result is negative, record 0, then add one admin charge. admin cannot be offset by the compensation described above. The original payment price cannot be used to relax the limit on additional expenditure. The assessed loss for the empty event is 0, with no admin or other charges. Unaffected items incur no adverse-event loss; there are no other unstated terms.

records.author: user
records.text: The attributes are complete and accurate, and are all nonnegative integers; monetary amounts are in fen of RMB, and weight is in grams. The original payment price must not exceed 1200000 fen of RMB, and the original payment and discount conditions stated in the contract must be satisfied. In each permitted event, the assessment amount described above must not exceed 200000 fen of RMB; equality with the limit is acceptable, and the limit must not be relaxed. This catalog is complete, with no hidden options.

records.author: user
records.text: Utility in each event is 2000000 minus price, then minus the assessment amount for that event. For candidates that satisfy the hard conditions and risk limits for all events simultaneously, take the lowest utility over all events, then choose the candidate with the greatest lowest utility; accept only if that value is strictly greater than 0, otherwise refuse. Do not ask the user questions.
